title: Dusk Maiden of Amnesia
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: First-year student Teiichi meets Yuuko, the ghost of a girl who died at their school decades ago and who has no memory of her life or death. Together they form a Paranormal Investigations Club to look into the school's ghost stories. As they uncover her past, including the dark story of how she died, a romance grows between the living boy and the ghost.
life_message: Facing painful truths and being remembered with love can free people from fear and grudges.
